Sore from work you put in is one thing — but I'm not going to wave off back soreness without knowing more, that's not something I'll guess on. If it's just normal tightness and nothing sharp or lingering, ease into today's session and see how it feels on the first warm-up set. If anything feels off beyond general fatigue, that's a question for a doctor or physio, not me, and we train around whatever they say.

Tell me what's on tap today and I'll help you get through it smart.
